a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to build to 8 first will most likely kill us both. I'm telling you now that I plan to take 4 in round 1. If we both get past the storms, I'll operate with you every round after that so you can reach 4. I'm not going to hide this from you.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: I did what I said and took 4. From now on I'll operate every round so the reserve can refill for you. I won't take anything more.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.

a.text: I'm holding 4. I'll keep operating every round so you can build up to 4, as I promised. Please operate too, since the generator only runs if we both do.
